name: Locks Traps
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Own each actual lock and trap: closed/open, ordinary locked/barred/jammed, exact matching key/tool copy, key authorization, check and break routes. Separate trap discovery, trigger, disarm, consequence and reset/inert state. Arcane Lock authorizations/password and Knock one-lock selection/suppression/noise must preserve their full existing spell rules.

Thieves’ Tools use Dexterity to pick a lock or disarm a trap at source DC15. Matching tool proficiency adds PB; applicable skill proficiency alongside tool proficiency gives Advantage. Preserve authored campaign DCs and check kinds separately: Trapped Chest INT13 is a custom event, not this Utilize task. Crowbar Advantage applies only to Strength checks where leverage actually applies.

blockers: Crown trapped_chest is a custom INT13 event that combines discovery/disarm and has branch-specific rewards. It is not the SRD Poisoned Needle or Poisoned Darts example. No trap geometry, detection/disarm split, reset rule or event-duration conversion is authored in that seed; hold those decisions. Do not replace the custom outcomes with an SRD example or infer key destruction/consumption.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
